dimensions.mission: One existing owner command can use exact C2 source while preserving C1 capture identity; the production consume remains behind its separate OPERATE gate.
dimensions.flexibility_and_history: Version-1 transfer packets and already imported releases stay readable; version-2 freezes mutable metadata once on the existing exporter. C1 source/release are never overwritten to make C2 pass.
dimensions.context_efficiency: One exact task and checkout, five Catalog source hashes, focused owner/contract tests and one C1/C2 disposable replay. No pre-PR full local gate; exact-head CI is mandatory. Material interrupted and dirty-tree checks are retained as failures, not promoted.
dimensions.research_truth: Closed closure, episode membership, point membership, field states, missingness and admission-time protection remain hash-bound. Transport identity changes do not broaden the scientific denominator, PIT clock or estimand.
dimensions.owner_operability: Ordinary unpack command returns explicit exact repeat, typed missing version and conflict; release-only historical replay names absent source and requires restoration before retention. One exact C2 OPERATE packet contains target, source, numerical oracle and stop conditions.
dimensions.execution_to_cashflow: This is evidence transport for exploratory research. It makes no trading, alpha, revenue, wallet or cashflow claim and authorizes no provider call.
dimensions.monitoring_and_recovery: Verified partial transfer fragments remain for same-packet retry; an imported historical release can answer only after full release, installed-byte and current metadata checks. Production recovery coverage must be independently read back under OPERATE.
dimensions.build_vs_buy: ADOPT existing capture/export, mirror, seal/import, Catalog and locked Python. WRAP mutable member-unit in capture-scoped views and an exporter-frozen snapshot. No new package, service, connector, provider or backup plane.
dimensions.security: Manifest self-hash, closure binding, safe relative paths, symlink refusal, bounded streaming size/hash checks and exclusive publication protect the transport seam. No credentials, external writes or live collector mutation.
dimensions.red_team: C1(8) to C2(24) is the original falsifier; changed immutable payload, wrong source bytes, missing historical source, altered installed release and missing current metadata must refuse or return explicitly limited verified fallback. Exact-head CI must validate the committed vertical route.

capability_radar.now: I1 exact software merge gate and separately authorized C2 consume. Value: delivery continuity; evidence: isolated exact C1/C2 replay. Owner activates only at exact merge phrase then distinct OPERATE gate; no new tool.
capability_radar.watch: Continuity checkpoint 2026-10-14 03:00 Moscow before 17 October intake stop. Re-read live grant/intake/storage state and choose an exact I3 continuation atom only if that trigger becomes due; no I2-I5 work is authorized here.

recovery: Before production C2 write, code can revert. After a new import, preserve C1 and every committed cohort; retry same packet or forward-repair import intent. Never delete lineage, overwrite shared unit metadata or restore a pre-C2 corpus snapshot over newer data.
